adam_preconditioned_v1.name: V1, Adam-preconditioned: the mean over q and e1 of adam_H - adam_S (never called LESS)

requirement: W1-04 (W1 builder extract rev 2, 18b81b26; addendum section 5 item 2; Draft C R7.4): REQ-25, report only
role: report only: never an arm and no edit file; the T1 A1 contract does not change

settings_section.comparisons: optional other top-600 sets (L1, H1, the classifier, as each exists): a stage-1 selection record ('selected') or an engine edit file ('remove'), each named by SHA-256 on the command line
settings_section.groups_guard_rule: per unit and checkpoint: the rows' mean cosine difference equals groups.json's harmful-minus-safe mean_cosine within checkpoint_cosine_tolerance; the rows' adam-difference sum equals groups.json's harmful-minus-safe adam_sum within checkpoint_adam_relative_tolerance times the sum of the absolute row terms and the absolute group value
settings_section.jaccard: |A intersect B| / |A union B| of two top-600 sets
settings_section.mean_identity_rule: (a^q + a^e1) / 2 equals T1's a_i for every row within the tolerance, or the report refuses
settings_section.role: report only: never an arm and no edit file; the T1 A1 contract does not change
settings_section.spearman: Spearman's rho = the Pearson correlation of average ranks (ties take the mean of their positions), over all training rows (stability) or over the 8 unit means (V1 against A1)
settings_section.ties_rule: each variant's top 600 by s1common.select_top with its own part (the variant name): score descending, then the sealed rank over all training row ids
